title: GravitationalVortex: Gravity from Vorticity via FFT-Poisson
description: Novel model where gravity emerges from vortex field. Density ρ(x) = κ·Σ|ω_i(x)|² is derived from vorticity, and gravitational potential satisfies ∇²φ = 4πGρ. Solved via FFT. Unlike classical approach (mass → gravity), here vorticity plays the role of mass.
